responsibility: Implements a read-only channel device that presents process argv data through the gm2 generic I/O framework. It copies command-line arguments into contiguous storage, keeps per-channel argument position state in RTdata, installs generic text/raw read hooks via RTgen/RTgenif, forbids writes by raising notAvailable, and provides ArgChan, IsArgPresent, and NextArg to advance between argv elements while preserving ordinary IOChan semantics.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the ProgramArgs pair: unlike ProgramArgs.def's small interface, it constructs the read-only argv-backed channel device, stores per-channel ArgInfo state via RTdata, copies argument strings into contiguous memory, and enforces no-write behavior through device exceptions.
